disputed_verses.KJV 1CH 15:9: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:

first_reader_said: 1CH 15:9: Both records are Eliel chief of the sons of Hebron with eighty brethren.

why: Both records identify the same Eliel in 1CH 15:9: chief of the sons of Hebron, with eighty brethren. A also includes 1CH 15:11, where David summons Eliel among the Levite leaders; B is a thinner duplicate with the same ancestry and office.
